input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, User roles. It manages core business objects including post, user, comment, role. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, my access denied handler, user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage post records, so that I can track and organize post data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage comment records, so that I can track and organize comment data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
